messages:
Maria (AE): Heads-up — banking prospect (Northbridge Capital) sent an RFI this morning. They need: private deployment (VPC), HSM-backed key storage, no logs persisted for inference, and regional data residency (EU only). POC asks 6–8 weeks. Need consolidated RFI + capability matrix + POC cost estimate by EOD Wed. Can ops/eng/security weigh in? :calendar:
Sanjay (Solutions): I'll own the POC plan. Proposed phases: 1) infra & security signoff, 2) connectivity + sample dataset, 3) load/burst test, 4) accuracy checks. Need a test harness; recommend subset of Redwood Optimize evals. I'll sketch milestones.
Olivia (Security): For RFI answers: SOC2 + ISO27001 docs are fine. For FedRAMP they're not asking yet but want FedRAMP-ready controls list. We need to be explicit about HSM: we support Cloud KMS + BYOK via HSM. We'll answer: keys never leave customer HSM; attestation available. I'll attach the control mapping.
Liam (Eng): HSM integration note: Private deployment supports PKCS#11 and AWS CloudHSM. For on-prem we'll need ~2 days of infra runbook work + certs. Regarding 'no logs' — we can turn off inference trace logging and set KV cache to ephemeral, but stack traces and crash dumps may still be produced; need to agree on retention policy in contract.
Maria (AE): @Olivia @Liam great. Sanjay can you draft the capability matrix columns: feature, supported (Y/N), notes, default config, POC config, SLA impact. Use the 'redwood-cap-matrix-v2.xlsx' as baseline but update HSM rows.
Sanjay (Solutions): Will do. Quick Q on pricing: customer wants a capped POC spend and per-unit price for Dedicated GPUs. Do we offer short-term reserved blocks? 
Liam (Eng): We can offer a 1-month reserved pool with commit pricing; estimate: 2x A100 for baseline load ~ $X/day. I'll put numbers but need someone from finance.
Maria (AE): Looping in @alex (sales-ops) offline for pricing finalize. 
Olivia (Security): Attaching control mappings: control_mapping_finserv_v3.pdf (uploaded). Also note: they require penetration test within POC window — recommend our standard PT partner; add 2 weeks.
deploy-bot: Artifact uploaded: capability_matrix_draft_v3.xlsx
Sanjay (Solutions): Attached sample curl to hit private endpoint for smoke test:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDFX_TOKEN" \
  -X POST https://private.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
Liam (Eng): Also adding sample env snippet for VPC peering:
```
VPC_PEER_ID=vpce-0abc123
ROUTE_TABLE=rtb-09c
```
Maria (AE): Solid. Can everyone please comment on the draft matrix before EOD Tue? I'll compile and send to customer Wed morning. :thumbsup:
Olivia (Security): I'll return RFI answers + FedRAMP control list by Tue noon.
Sanjay (Solutions): Matrix draft pushed to thread. Please review. 
Maria (AE): Thanks all — closing loop after reviews.
